Sallow distinguishes commercial coordination from knowledge of each customer's unlawful conduct. He says 'There are three trading households that operate together under a joint freight account. Demeric Harthvale is the man who heads their association. The broker works on their behalf. They can offer much more than inspection notices: reliable space on cargo boats, preferred access to imported goods, and arrangements for regular customers. I deal with them for my lady's purchases. I can't tell you what every other customer knows, and I don't make a habit of discussing their accounts.' He offers a concrete next route: 'If you are interested in the supply side as well as Tavosk's services, I can ask the broker to introduce you to Harthvale. He's the man I would speak with about a larger arrangement.' No actual message, appointment, proposal, deal, second note, payment, guaranteed availability, new participant or unrelated criminal conspiracy. No named unrelated customer established as criminal. No claim of any other specific offense, murder connection or wider network beyond actual disclosure. V/Mara/Cirren/Fenar hear this; Watch not yet informed. V retains earlier Sallow signed referral to Tavosk and handwritten notes. V next choice pending in Sallow office; no resource/custody change.
